note: Sample Spotlight trade cards for education. Not a live list, not advice.

cards.name: Freeport-McMoRan
cards.title: Upside Calls Cheap in Metals Leader for AI Buildout
idea: A copper leader framed as an AI-buildout supplier: grid, data-center wiring, and power all pull on the metal.
The card prefers upside calls while implied volatility is described as cheap, and puts the exit on the stock, not on the option price.
cards.recommendation: Sample read: long calls, managed on the stock. Respect the $63 stock stop; the $80 stock target is the planned exit. Size is not on the card.

cards.name: Visa
cards.title: Call Spreads into the Payments Quarter
idea: Payments volume into the quarter, with the card choosing call spreads to lower the cost of upside exposure.
A spread caps the gain at the short strike in exchange for a smaller debit.
cards.recommendation: Sample read: call spreads into the print. The card names no strikes, stop, or target, so no trade levels are drawn.

cards.name: Nu Holdings
cards.title: Long Calls in Brazilian Financial Growth Leader
idea: A Latin American digital bank growing customers and deposits faster than the incumbents it competes with.
The card frames long calls as the way to hold the growth story with a defined cost.
cards.recommendation: Sample read: long calls with defined risk. The card names no stock stop or target, so no trade levels are drawn.
